title: Dimensional Phase Transition / 4D↔5D Door — Full Recovery and Critical-Phenomena Model
status: conversation-developed physical toy-model program built around Tim's dimensional-collapse intuition; later quantitative integration added
scientific_abstract: This model translates Tim Dooley's recurring intuition that extreme compression, curvature, density and scale might coincide with a change in effective dimensional description into a falsifiable critical-phenomena programme. The central improvement is nondimensionalization: compactness, curvature, density, energy and length are represented by separate dimensionless controls rather than added as incompatible raw quantities. A scalar order parameter phi is then coupled to a latent dimensionless threshold Xi through a Landau-style potential, and a bounded map sends the order parameter continuously from an effective four-dimensional regime toward, but not beyond, five dimensions. An exact Schwarzschild calculation demonstrates why the distinction among controls matters: horizon compactness is C_h=1/2 for every mass, whereas horizon Kretschmann curvature is K_h=(3/4)c^8/(G^4 M^4). Thus a compactness-triggered transition and a curvature-triggered transition make radically different mass-dependent claims. The model remains speculative and is not evidence that black holes open a fifth dimension; its scientific value lies in turning a broad idea of 'compression' into separable variables, critical scaling, measurable deviations from general relativity, and explicit falsification conditions.
provenance: User supplied recurring physical intuition including matter becoming too condensed and transitioning into another dimension; size/scale matters; black holes as transition candidates; matter/light and collapse/emergence relations. Explicit Lagrangians, scalar order parameter, spectral-dimension formulas, nondimensionalized threshold, Landau critical scaling and proposed observables are assistant/archive-developed translations unless separately recovered as Tim-authored.
research_question: Can a mathematically coherent effective theory be constructed in which a dimensionless combination of gravitational/scale controls drives an order parameter that changes the effective dimensional description, while recovering ordinary 4D gravity outside the transition regime and producing distinguishable observables near it?
core_hypothesis: Effective dimensionality is treated as a dynamical/scale-dependent quantity that may change when a specified dimensionless control state crosses a critical regime. No such transition has been empirically established by this project.
baseline_model: General relativity plus the Standard Model and conventional black-hole perturbation theory in the regime being tested. Any new Door model must recover this baseline as the new coupling/order parameter vanishes.

dimensionless_control_state.first_calibratable_ansatz: Xi=w^T z after features are standardized/defined consistently; weights w are fitted parameters, not fundamental constants
dimensionless_control_state.reason: This prevents dimensionally incompatible quantities from being added directly and makes competing trigger hypotheses testable.

field_template: V(phi;Xi)=1/2 a(Xi_c-Xi)phi^2+1/4 lambda phi^4, with a>0 and lambda>0

critical_structure.symmetric_regime: Xi<Xi_c -> stable minimum phi=0 in this mean-field ansatz
critical_structure.critical_scaling: |phi| proportional to (Xi-Xi_c)^(1/2) just above Xi_c under mean-field assumptions
critical_structure.susceptibility_question: If an external source J_phi is added, response d<phi>/dJ_phi near the transition becomes a measurable critical-response target rather than an undefined notion of sensitivity.
critical_structure.status: archive-generated Landau-style toy model; exponent 1/2 is an ansatz-level mean-field result, not a prediction of unknown microscopic quantum gravity.

bounded_effective_dimension.older_ansatz: D_eff=4+eta phi^2/M_*^2 can grow without bound and therefore does not encode a specifically 4-to-5 transition by itself.
bounded_effective_dimension.interpretation: This is a bounded measurement/interpretation map from the order parameter into an effective dimension label; it is not derived from spectral geometry and must not be confused with the measured spectral dimension D_s.

door_as_domain_wall: A spatially varying solution may interpolate between phi≈0 and phi!=0 across a finite transition region. Calling that region a Door is project language; an actual domain-wall solution requires solving the field equation with specified boundary conditions.

gravity_triggers.key_result: C_h is mass-independent while K_h scales as M^-4. Compactness and local curvature therefore encode different notions of gravitational extremity.
gravity_triggers.model_selection_consequence: A C-only threshold would treat all ideal Schwarzschild horizons identically. A chi/K threshold strongly favors smaller-mass horizons for fixed ell_*. A mixed model can interpolate but its weights must be inferred/constrained rather than chosen to force a desired result.

spectral_dimension_branch.definition: D_s(sigma)=-2 d ln P(sigma)/d ln sigma
spectral_dimension_branch.candidate_hypothesis: D_s could approach a value near 5 over a specified diffusion-scale window in a proposed transition regime.
spectral_dimension_branch.measurement_requirement: Specify the diffusion/return probability P(sigma), geometry/ensemble, scale window and uncertainty. A label D_eff≈5 from the scalar ansatz is not evidence that spectral dimension is 5.

matter_light_coupling: candidate new operator g_phi phi F_mn F^mn requires a coupling with appropriate mass dimension depending on [phi]
research question: would the specified transition branch alter electromagnetic propagation/emission beyond conventional plasma, QED and curved-spacetime effects?
baseline requirement: conventional environmental/astrophysical emission mechanisms must be modeled before attributing anomalies to phi
five_dimensional_gravity: S_5=(1/(2 kappa_5)) integral d^5x sqrt(-G)(R_5-2 Lambda_5)+S_matter
five_dimensional_gravity.known_limit: When the extra-dimensional modes/order parameter decouple or compactification scale is inaccessible, the effective action must approach the accepted 4D baseline within observational limits.

kaluza_klein_branch.interpretive_lesson: Hidden-dimensional momentum can appear to a 4D observer as a mass tower rather than literal visible disappearance.
kaluza_klein_branch.constraint_logic: If R_5 is large enough to make modes accessible, experiments constrain their masses/couplings; if R_5 is tiny, the branch can decouple but becomes harder to use for macroscopic Door claims.

black_hole_observables.mode_content: possible extra gravitational/scalar polarizations or quasinormal modes if the chosen action supports them
black_hole_observables.measurement_rule: A branch must derive the sign, frequency/mass dependence and amplitude of at least one deviation before observations can test it. Writing Delta alone is a placeholder, not a prediction.

cosmology_recycling_branch.serious_target: derive an effective Friedmann equation and a(t) from explicit higher-dimensional boundary/compactification conditions rather than narrating collapse->reservoir->emergence
cosmology_recycling_branch.interpretive_rule: If energy-momentum is exchanged between sectors, the full theory must state the embedding/projection and conserve the total stress-energy according to its equations.

duality_branch.status: formal analogy until a state space and transformation law are specified
duality_branch.test: Identify an invariant I with I[T(X)]=I[X] and show the action/equations transform consistently; otherwise 'collapse↔emergence' remains symbolic polarity rather than a physical duality.

parameter_identifiability.problem: C, K, rho, E and L are often correlated functions of mass, radius and environment. A multivariate Xi may therefore be poorly identifiable from limited astrophysical observations.
parameter_identifiability.fisher: I_ab=E[(partial_a ln p(Y|Theta))(partial_b ln p(Y|Theta))] under standard regularity assumptions
parameter_identifiability.rule: If parameters/weights produce nearly indistinguishable observables, report constrained combinations instead of pretending each trigger has been separately measured.

measurement_and_testing.uncertainty: Instrument uncertainty, source/environment uncertainty and theoretical waveform/model discrepancy must be separated.
measurement_and_testing.baseline: GR/Kerr or the appropriate standard cosmological/particle model
measurement_and_testing.strong_prediction: Predeclare parameter region and derive a correlated signature across more than one observable, e.g. ringdown frequency + damping + extra mode pattern, rather than fitting one anomaly after the fact.
measurement_and_testing.known_limit: Theta_new->0 or Xi<<Xi_c must reproduce baseline predictions within established constraints.

falsification_conditions: A proposed parameter region is ruled out if it predicts deviations larger than observational bounds and no independently justified screening/decoupling mechanism exists.
A compactness-only claim is weakened if the hypothesized effect demonstrably depends on mass/local curvature in a way C alone cannot encode.
A claim that D_s approaches 5 is unsupported unless return-probability/diffusion observables actually yield that scaling over a specified range.
If a Door model cannot derive any observable distinct from GR/standard EFT for any plausible parameter regime, it remains interpretation rather than empirical extension.
compressed_transition_grammar: dimensionless control state z -> latent threshold Xi -> critical surface Xi_c -> order parameter phi -> modified effective regime -> observation map -> quantitative comparison with baseline
conclusions: The strongest improvement is conceptual decomposition: compactness, curvature, density, energy and size are related but non-identical physical controls.
The exact Schwarzschild result C_h=1/2 while K_h∝M^-4 gives the project a concrete example of why one word such as 'compression' can hide physically different regimes.
A bounded D_eff map better expresses a proposed 4-to-5 transition than an unbounded polynomial, but it remains an ansatz until tied to spectral/geometric observables.
The Landau potential turns Door into a calculable threshold model with an order parameter and critical scaling, while making clear which structure is assumed rather than derived.
Black-hole phenomenology requires deriving actual Delta f, Delta tau, extra-mode or propagation signatures from a chosen action; symbolic gateways do not supply those values.

The model becomes scientifically stronger by becoming narrower: one branch, one dimensionless trigger family, one known limit and one correlated observational signature should be solved before expanding back toward a general cosmology.
research_boundary: This is a mathematically useful speculative program, not evidence that black holes actually open a fifth dimension or that a phi field exists. Its value is that it turns Tim's repeated dimensional-threshold intuition into typed variables, equations, critical behavior and potentially falsifiable deviations.
